entries.2c0262c0caa2c169: The group has built a logistics delivery network that can respond to the various needs of corporate customers, such as shape, frequency, and quantity, and has focused on undertaking "from B" logistics operations combining BtoB (business-to-business) and BtoC (business-to-consumer). Building on this network, it provides "Total Logistics," which optimizes customers' entire supply chains by combining not only the transport and delivery of parcels but also handling of products requiring low-temperature management, warehouse storage and distribution processing, and international transport. The business flow has a structure in which the logistics solutions provided by the Delivery Business, Logistics Business, and Global Logistics Business are supported, as business infrastructure, by the logistics incidental services belonging to the Real Estate Business and "Other." The number of parcels handled by the Delivery Business was 1,360 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026 (1,308 million in the previous fiscal year, on figures after the change in the scope of aggregation), of which Hikyaku Takkyubin accounted for 1,324 million (1,271 million in the previous fiscal year). Sales drivers responsible for pickup and sales activities numbered approximately 20,000 as of March 31, 2026. In the Logistics Business, in July 2024 it brought Meito Transportation Co., Ltd. (formerly C&F Logi Holdings Co., Ltd.) into the group and obtained a foundation for low-temperature logistics (cold chain). In the Global Logistics Business, EXPOLANKA HOLDINGS Limited has strengths in apparel transport from Asia to North America, and Morrison Express Worldwide Corporation, brought into the group in May 2025, has strengths in the transport of semiconductor equipment and high-tech products. The Real Estate Business develops integrated logistics facilities such as SRC for the Delivery Business and Logistics Business, obtains funds for developing new facilities by converting group-owned logistics facilities into trust beneficiary rights and selling them, and SG Asset Max Co., Ltd. handles asset management and operation after the sale.

entries.3376e4caeb4436af: Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,644,762 million, an increase of 11.2% compared with the previous fiscal year. This was mainly due to the consolidation effects of Meito/Hutech, brought into the group from the third quarter of the fiscal year ended March 2025, and of Morrison, brought into the group from the second quarter of the fiscal year ended March 2026. In existing businesses, a 4% increase in the number of parcels handled by the Delivery Business compared with the previous fiscal year contributed to the revenue increase. On the other hand, at Expolanka in the Global Logistics Business, air volumes fell below those of the same period of the previous year, and air and sea freight rates trended downward due to factors including the impact of US trade policy, resulting in a decrease in revenue. Operating revenue from external customers was ¥1,048,510 million for the Delivery Business (up 4.5% from the previous fiscal year), ¥321,596 million for the Global Logistics Business (up 25.4%), ¥202,798 million for the Logistics Business (up 41.7%), ¥15,434 million for the Real Estate Business (down 35.6%), and ¥56,421 million for Other (up 6.9%). Revenue from contracts with customers was ¥1,614,988 million, and other revenue was ¥29,774 million. The figures for the previous fiscal year have been reclassified after the change in the classification of reporting segments.

entries.bda1114a296cb9a3: In March 2022, it formulated the long-term vision "SGH Vision 2030" (Grow the new Story.) covering the period to the fiscal year ending March 2031, and in March 2025 it defined its vision of what it wants to be as continuing to be an indispensable presence (= infrastructure) for customers and society. Its management targets for the fiscal year ending March 2031 are operating revenue of ¥2.2 trillion and profit attributable to owners of parent of ¥98 billion. Toward realizing them, it is advancing the medium-term management plan "SGH Story 2027" for the fiscal years ended March 2026 to ending March 2028, whose basic policy is advancement of total logistics and expansion of the global logistics base, and whose strategies are the 3 of (1) expansion of domestic service fields and the global logistics base, (2) expansion of management resources supporting growth, and (3) efforts toward sustainable management. In the first year of the medium-term management plan, in the delivery business cross-border EC, a growth field, grew and it achieved its volume target ahead of plan, while in part of the global logistics business delays from plan arose due to factors such as United States trade policy and geopolitical risks.
entries.be80794dbb863258: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥59,066 million, an increase of 1.6% compared with the previous fiscal year. On the expense side, in the Delivery Business it raised outsourcing unit prices to partner companies and implemented base pay increases for employees, and costs, centered on personnel and outsourcing expenses, are trending upward. entries.fe69524d5ab39271: SG HOLDINGS CO.,LTD. is a pure holding company, established in March 2006 through a sole share transfer that made Sagawa Express Co., Ltd. a wholly owned subsidiary. The group consists of the company, 201 consolidated subsidiaries, and 7 affiliated companies accounted for by the equity method, and engages in the Delivery Business, Logistics Business, Global Logistics Business, Real Estate Business, and other businesses. The number of employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 60,483. Its corporate philosophy is to improve services and quality under the founding spirit of the "Spirit of Hikyaku (Hikyaku no Kokoro)" by responding to the trust of customers and society and growing together with them, creating new value and contributing to the development of society, and always continuing to take on challenges and pursuing every possibility. The company and its consolidated subsidiary SG HOLDINGS GLOBAL PTE. LTD. (overseas business oversight) are corporate (common) divisions that do not provide solutions or services, and do not belong to any reporting segment.
